up: Show the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1822 (Inosine-5'-monophosphate dehydrogenase 1). Return assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Use only exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values, and order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value,
  a.value,
  a.units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.activity_id,
  a.assay_id,
  a.molregno
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE
  a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1822'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
ORDER BY a.molregno, a.assay_id
LIMIT 1000
